title: Emit the physical raw dual of #4935 with independent verification and a scoped ceiling (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Supply the missing physical raw inverse transpose of #4935's source-restored involutory producer. The literal new backward word returns `X'=X-F^T Y, Y'=Y` in its actual conjugated source charts, preserving all 632 original inputs and 408 independent helper jobs and resetting the existing owned C0. The source-mutating UNIT-TRANSFER variant is excluded.

Start with #4929's unchanged backward word. For each of #4935's eight selected Y ports, copy its pure final observation into owned C0, apply its actual rank-one lift to the common full X chart, scatter the dyadic correction `-12(PR)^T`, then clear C0. The suffix has 8H1,424 weighted ADDs,8COPY and 16CLEAR. The complete paid profile is `{1:2209,2:412,3:510,4:127,5:40}`, exactly the forward4935 invoice. No extra array or productive reward is created. The conservative finite allowance is 3064 extra elementary array passes outside the eight recursive calls; precision amplification and compiler funding remain separate.

This is a positive physical interface result, with a changed transfer contract. It is not an unchanged-output saving or a complete caller. The replayed word and `science/RESULT.json.paid` are authoritative: retained `canonical.local_profile` is baseline4929 metadata.

A separate source-specific ONE-parallel-bank ceiling checks `diag(F)=12D_J`, `F_JJ=12I` and invertibility of the off-diagonal part. Its grade-two projection requires112H2 under the stated finite columnwise Clifford grammar. That bill loses throughout C∈[.0030217758,.0034] even granting an unrealized224H17+2H reward; its lower-endpoint margin is enclosed by[-73.269156882594712940928576503039,-73.269156882594712940928576503038]. This excludes only the specified standalone adapter architecture. It does not obstruct this repair, a direct coded caller or chronological native absorption.

All seven original emitter files,29 independent-review files and ten raw source blobs are byte-preserved. COPY/CLEAR are not claimed to transpose generically. No full multiplier cold replay, Lean kernel, complete caller, compiler reserve or outer admission was run. [Exact-head hosted run39894299781](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39894299781) passed:357 helper tests/11 expected skips, all eight registered normal/optimized source-bound commands and the committed-input integrity gate.
